content.short: Haedal is a leading liquid staking protocol on Sui that enables users to earn staking rewards while staying liquid.
content.description: Haedal is a premier liquid staking protocol natively built on the Sui blockchain, designed to unlock the liquidity of staked SUI tokens. By providing users with haSUI in exchange for their deposits, the platform allows participants to continue earning network validator rewards while simultaneously utilizing their assets in other DeFi protocols. Haedal focuses on providing a secure and highly efficient staking experience, featuring a user-friendly interface and deep integration with the Sui ecosystem. The protocol plays a vital role in enhancing the capital efficiency of the Sui network, ensuring that users don't have to choose between securing the blockchain and participating in decentralized finance activities.
content.meta: Haedal offers secure liquid staking for SUI on the Sui network, allowing users to earn rewards while maintaining asset liquidity.
